children: Chegg repaid the remaining $33.9 million of 0% convertible senior notes at maturity and is now debt-free.
Repaid $33.9 million aggregate principal of 0% convertible senior notes due Sept. 1, 2026, at maturity.
2026 Notes fully retired; Chegg reports no outstanding debt following repayment.
As of June 30, 2026, Chegg held $72 million in cash, equivalents and investments.
Pro forma for the repayment, cash, equivalents and investments would be approximately $38 million.
CFO says debt-free status provides greater financial flexibility to execute strategy and create shareholder value.
